gloss: summer resort; retreat from the heat

definitions.gloss: summer resort; retreat from the heat
definitions.explanation: A place, typically in the mountains or at higher elevations, where people go to escape the summer heat. These areas are naturally cooler than cities.

examples.japanese: ⟦{軽井沢|かるいざわ}→軽井沢：30713_karuizawa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な{避暑地|ひしょち}だ。
examples.english: Karuizawa is a famous summer resort.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{避暑地|ひしょち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}かける→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Every summer, many families head to summer resorts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{都会|とかい}→都会：02475_tokai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{猛暑|もうしょ}→猛暑：08311_mousho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{避|さ}けて→避ける：02109_sakeru⟧、⟦{涼|すず}しい→涼しい：00674_suzushii⟧⟦{高原|こうげん}→高原：05497_kougen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{避暑地|ひしょち}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{一週間|いっしゅうかん}→一週間：10979_isshuukan⟧ほど⟦{過|す}ごした→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧。
examples.english: Escaping the intense heat of the city, I spent about a week at a cool highland summer resort.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
Famous Japanese summer resorts include ⟦{軽井沢|かるいざわ}→軽井沢：30713_karuizawa⟧ (Karuizawa), {那須|なす} (Nasu), and ⟦{箱根|はこね}→箱根：30712_hakone⟧ (Hakone). The concept became popular during the Meiji era when foreign residents and Japanese elite began retreating to the mountains in summer. These areas typically feature cooler temperatures, forests, and a relaxed atmosphere.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {避暑地|ひしょち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧ (to go to a summer resort)
- {避暑地|ひしょち}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{知|し}られる→知る：00458_shiru⟧ (to be known as a summer resort)
- ⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{避暑地|ひしょち} (a popular summer resort)
